title: Global medical disclaimer
rule: All content is educational and not diagnosis, treatment or medical advice. Users with symptoms, pregnancy, postpartum, child/baby profiles, chronic disease, injury or medication should get professional clearance.

title: Pregnancy stop signs
rule: Stop and seek care for bleeding, fluid leakage, regular painful contractions, dizziness/fainting, chest pain, calf swelling, severe headache, shortness of breath before exertion, or reduced fetal movement.

title: Pregnancy programming
rule: Default pregnancy content should be moderate, low-fall-risk, no contact sports, no overheating, no breath-holding and professionally reviewed.

title: Baby content
rule: Baby category is developmental play only. No workouts, no added weights, no forced stretching, no shaking, no sleep positioning advice, and adult supervision is required.

title: Children and supplements
rule: Children/teens should focus on fluids, food, training, conditioning and rest. Do not prompt protein powders, creatine, stimulants, pre-workouts or fat burners.

title: Progression rule
rule: Use 5-10% volume/load changes at most for adults when recovery is good. Beginners progress slower. Pain or form loss means regress.

title: BMI note
rule: BMI is a screening metric, not a full health diagnosis. Pair it with waist, performance, health history, age, pregnancy status and professional advice.

title: Allergies
rule: Nutrition recommendations must check allergens, diet preference, religious restrictions, pregnancy status, age, medication and medical conditions before suggesting foods.

title: Advanced training
rule: Very high intensity is adult-only and should require readiness checks, warm-up, deloads, sleep/recovery monitoring and explicit warnings.

title: YouTube media
rule: Do not download/rehost YouTube videos. Store embed URLs only when rights and policy are verified; store license/attribution metadata.
